description: This file provides functions for generating UUIDs using cryptographic APIs. It defines a CryptoLike type, implements uuid creation from bytes, and exports generateUUID function that utilizes the Web Crypto API or falls back with warnings.

methods.name: function uuidFromBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): string { uuidFromBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a UUID string, setting version and variant bits according to UUID v4 standard.

methods.name: function warnWeakCryptoOnce() { warnWeakCryptoOnce
methods.description: Logs a warning once if crypto API is missing, indicating insecure UUID generation.

methods.name: export function generateUUID(cryptoLike: CryptoLike | null = globalThis.crypto): string { generateUUID
methods.description: Generates a UUID using crypto APIs, falling back with warning if not available.
